AfterObtained.rationale: PaelsHorn.cs:17-26 loops `for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)`, building `base.Owner.RunState.CreateCard<Relax>(base.Owner)` and awaiting `CardPileCmd.Add(card, PileType.Deck)` each time. paels_horn.py:19-20 loops CARDS = 2 (:14) over `run.add_card(make_card("relax"))`. The count is a bare literal 2 -- the relic declares no CanonicalVars and no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension -- so 2 is the pinned value. The two C# calls collapse correctly onto one sim call: RunState.CreateCard (RunState.cs:383-389) is ToMutable + AddCard + AfterCreated, i.e. it registers the card with the run, and CardPileCmd.Add then places it in the Deck pile; run.add_card does both, and it dispatches the same two deck hooks C#'s Add fires -- Hook.ModifyCardBeingAddedToDeck (so the egg relics can upgrade the Relax) and RelicModel.AfterCardChangedPiles for the deck pile (so Darkstone Periapt sees it), at run.py:524-536. Position matches: CardPilePosition.Bottom is Add's default (CardPileCmd.cs:259) and run.add_card appends. CardCmd.PreviewCardPileAdd (line 25) is presentation. (2026-08-04 re-audit: run.py had drifted; re-verified add_card's two-hook shape is unchanged.)

guards.what: N1: the added card's identity -- `CreateCard<Relax>` vs `make_card("relax")`
guards.rationale: sts2_rl/cards/relax.py registers id 'relax' and is the port of Relax.cs; ExtraHoverTips' `FromCardWithCardHoverTips<Relax>` (PaelsHorn.cs:15) names the same card and is presentation. The cards are created at upgrade level 0 on both sides (ToMutable of the canonical card; a fresh Card instance).

guards.what: N2: PaelsHorn does NOT override HasUponPickupEffect, and the sim does not set has_upon_pickup_effect
guards.rationale: Checked deliberately because three other units in this batch (paels_tooth, pandoras_box, pear) DO override it and the flag feeds RelicModel.IsTradable (relics/base.py:188-199). The flags agree, and Ancient rarity excludes the relic from trading on both sides regardless.

guards.rationale: Executed grep over the batch's C# files finds no IsAllowed override (sweep B's cluster excludes this unit). Neither CreateCard nor CardPileCmd.Add takes an Rng, so unlike a transform-based pickup (contrast pandoras_box in this batch, which names Rng.Niche) there is no stream to lose. Obtainability: Ancient, offered by the ported Pael shrine from OptionPool1 (Pael.cs:30-36; events/pael.py OPTION_POOL_1).

guards.rationale: The C# body has no guard clauses at all (not even an IsDead check, unlike PaelsTooth.cs:95), and neither does the port. Recorded so the absence is on the record rather than looking like an omission.
